description: Changes an existing circuit as asked in plain words, such as "make the two resistors parallel", "add a voltmeter across the LED" or "use a 12V supply", or answers a question about it. Use this when the person has a circuit and asks to change it, or asks "what does this capacitor do?" or "why is this resistor here?". Takes a CircuitJS circuit or a breadboardhub.com/sim link. The changed circuit passes breadboardhub's structural checks; a change that would break it is refused and the circuit comes back unchanged. Returns the new circuit or the answer, a link that opens the circuit running live, and the parts list with supplier search links. Takes up to a minute. Counts toward the daily design limit.

change.description: What to change, or a question about the circuit, in plain words (3 to 1,000 characters).

circuit.description: The circuit: CircuitJS (falstad.com/circuit) text, a "$" options line then one part per line such as "r 176 112 304 112 0 220" for a 220 ohm resistor (at most 20,000 characters), or a breadboardhub.com/sim link that carries one.

purpose.description: Optional: what the circuit is for, in plain words (at most 1,000 characters). Helps keep the change in line with it.

name: edit_circuit
title: Change a circuit
